header: ES 411 OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND SAFETY I – FINAL EXAM – January 2025
instructions: This examination is comprised of 25 multiple-choice questions. Each question is followed by three or four possible answers, of which only one is correct. The maximum time for this examination is 40 minutes.
notes: Başlık sayfası (S1–6) 'January 2025' yazıyor; devam sayfalarında (S7–15, S16–25) sadece 'FINAL EXAM' var, ancak S6'dan S7'ye içerik/numara sürekliliği ve aynı yazı tipi/düzen nedeniyle aynı sınav kabul edildi.

Ağustos 2024 finaliyle (es411-final-2024-08) aynı soru havuzunu kullanıyor ama ayrı bir sınav: süre 40 dk (Ağustos'ta 30 dk), başında etik/4857-6331 soruları ekli, soru sırası ve numaralandırma farklı; Ağustos'taki 'hazard level of the company' ve 'advantage of ergonomics' soruları burada yok.
Fotoğraflarda öğrenci işareti yok; tüm cevaplar çözülerek belirlendi.
S5 şık c fotoğrafta kesik; Ağustos kopyasıyla tamamlandı ('getting paid').

items.text: Which one of these cannot be considered a reason for workplace ethics?

options.t: Increasing profits at the expense of safety
Fostering social responsibility within the organization

items.text: Which Turkish law emphasizes the principle of non-discrimination in the workplace?

options.t: Occupational Health and Safety Law No. 6331
Social Insurance and Universal Health Insurance Law No. 5510

items.remark: Eşit davranma ilkesi 4857 sayılı İş Kanunu md. 5'te düzenlenir; ancak ders notlarında 6331 (A) vurgulanmış olabilir, belirsiz.

items.text: Which of these best fits the definition of hazard in occupational health and safety?

options.t: the chance or probability that a person will be harmed
harm or adverse health effects on something or someone
an incident where no injury or illness occurs

items.remark: Soru numarası fotoğrafta kenarda kesik; sıra gereği 3.

items.text: Which of these best fits the definition of risk in occupational health and safety?

options.t: the chance or probability that a person will be harmed
harm or adverse health effects on something or someone
an incident where no injury or illness occurs

items.text: Which one of these does not refer to the factors that influence the degree of risk in a workplace?

options.t: how much a person is exposed to a hazardous thing or condition in the workplace
how severe are the effects under the conditions of exposure in the workplace
how much a person is getting paid in the workplace
how a person is exposed to hazardous things or conditions

items.text: In a factory, a CNC milling machine creates a tolerable level of risk due to its broken part that is impossible to replace. The design of the machine does not allow the use of any engineering measure (e.g. barriers) to prevent a potential hazard. What is the best control measure for this situation?

list: I. The work accident is only accepted when the insurance holder is at the workplace
II. A work accident occurs when a worker carries out his/her main work when he/she is sent on duty to another place out of the workplace,
III. When a worker commutes to work on a vehicle provided by the employer.
